title: PM-RKVY Absorbs 3 Agriculture Schemes into ₹1.75 Lakh Crore Umbrella
summary: PM-RKVY folds Krishonnati Yojana, Natural Farming, and Honey Mission into 5-year 16th Finance Commission cycle.

blocks.content: Cabinet approved restructuring PM-RKVY into a **₹1.75 lakh crore umbrella scheme** over 5 years (FY26–FY31), merging three major agri-programmes.

items: **Absorbed Schemes**: Krishonnati Yojana, National Mission on Natural Farming, National Bee and Honey Mission.
